title: credential-composer-and-lightweight-stream-iterator-facade-cross-sdk-version-sync
author: Ivy Chang
description: Context & motivation: multiple SDK consumers reported complexity around composing credential fallbacks (refresh tokens, delegated keys, environment chains) and repeated boilerplate for resumable/peekable async stream consumers. This PR introduces a language-agnostic design implemented in each SDK: a Credential Composer (pluggable fallback chains + deterministic metrics hooks) and a Lightweight Stream Iterator Facade (peekable async/pullstream helper, graceful cancel/shutdown semantics, typed cursor hints). Goals: reduce auth boilerplate, provide parity of ergonomics across Python/TS/Go, and align minor SDK versions. What changed (summary): 1) New credential/composer abstraction + implementation in py/ts/go that supports prioritized fallback, prefetch, and metrics hooks; 2) Stream iterator facade in each SDK with peek(), drain(), graceful_close() helpers and explicit abort semantics; 3) Centralized retry-presets module and backoff profiles with deterministic unit tests; 4) Minor API adjustments to auth init signatures to accept ComposerOptions; 5) Version bumps: python 0.37.0 -> 0.38.0, typescript 2.1.3 -> 2.2.0, go 1.5.8 -> 1.6.0; 6) Updated examples and migration notes. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked in Linear (ENG-5789) - [x] Unit tests for all languages - [x] Integration smoke tests against hosted sandbox - [x] Docs + migration note - [x] SDK version bump PRs coordinated Commits: "initial credential-composer sketch (py/ts/go)"; "stream iterator facade + tests"; "centralize retry presets"; "fix flaky stream test + CI flake guard"; "release bumps and changelogs". Changed files (high level): - sdk/python/redwood/credentials/composer.py (new) - sdk/python/redwood/streams/iterator_facade.py (new) - sdk/python/tests/test_composer.py, test_iterator.py - sdk/typescript/src/credentials/composer.ts - sdk/typescript/src/streams/iteratorFacade.ts - sdk/go/credentials/composer.go - sdk/go/streams/iterator_facade.go - docs/sdk/migration/credential-composer.md - examples/quickstarts/streaming-credential-compose.{py,ts} Small illustrative snippet (py, inline): "composer = CredentialComposer([EnvProvider(), DelegatedKeyProvider()], prefetch=True); stream = StreamIterator(client.chat(...), composer=composer); item = stream.peek()" Review thread (selected): "Mateo: Nice design; can we make metrics hooks optional and non-blocking?" "Ivy: metrics are no-op by default, added non-blocking queue + unit tests" "Jolene: TS types need clearer generics on peek()" "Ivy: adjusted generic signatures and added tests; PTAL" "Aleksei: golang naming conventions look good; consider context.Context propagation" "Ivy: propagated context to facade.CloseWithContext(ctx) and updated docs" CI history: initial CI run failed on 'sdk/python/tests/test_iterator.py::test_resume' (flaky race). Root cause: race in test harness when simulated server closed a connection during peek(); fix: added deterministic server stub and retry-guard; re-ran full CI. Final CI: all checks pass (unit, linter, typecheck, integration smoke). Manual QA: performed cross-language smoke run against sandbox region eu-west-1; validated token rotation and stream resume under throttling. Migration notes: callers that previously passed raw token providers should adapt to CredentialComposer.wrap(old_provider) or use ComposerOptions.fallbacks to preserve behavior. Release notes: "Added Credential Composer (pluggable fallback chains) and Stream Iterator Facade across Python/TS/Go; centralized retry presets; SDK minor version bumps and migration guidance." Breaking changes: "auth init signature now accepts ComposerOptions object (backwards-compatible via helper wrap); callers using positional args for auth init should update (see migration doc)". Merge outcome: merged via squash on 2026-02-22 after approvals from all reviewers; backported small doc fix to release branch for migration note. Impact & follow-ups: schedule a deprecation PR in 8 weeks for legacy raw-provider signature, monitor metrics emitted by composer (ENG-5790), and coordinate with platform to expose composer telemetry in Console.
